column1: Purpose: Log every piece of LinkedIn content you publish, so the Dashboard can show you how much you're actually producing.
1. These columns are a starting point. Add or remove columns to match what you actually track. Don't touch the Dashboard's formulas unless you update what they point to.
2. Log one row every time you publish something on LinkedIn.
3. Pick the Content Type from the dropdown, add the Title or Description and the URL, and set Quantity.
4. Pull this data automatically if you can, RSS feeds, Google Apps Script, platform APIs, Zapier, or a scraper. Otherwise update it manually at least once a day.
